title: All-n finite-block reduction for adjacent weighted Dirichlet gaps
headline_value: For every n>=2 and R>1, both gap extrema exist and every extremizer is bang-bang with at most 2n switches
scope: All measurable densities 1<=rho<=R a.e. on (0,1), every finite R>1, every integer n>=2, both global maxima and minima
main_limitation: No symmetry, uniqueness, exact-switch, optimizer-pattern, optimal-value, or novelty claim; not formal-proof-assistant verified

title: Universal exact-2n switching theorem for adjacent weighted Dirichlet gaps
headline_value: For every finite R>1 and n>=2, every global maximizer and minimizer has exactly 2n effective switches
scope: All measurable densities 1<=rho<=R a.e. on (0,1), every finite R>1, every integer n>=2, both global maxima and minima, and every extremizer
main_limitation: No symmetry, uniqueness, explicit switch locations, closed optimal-gap formula, infinite-contrast theorem, formal-proof-assistant verification, or novelty claim

title: Fixed-n small-contrast uniqueness for multiphase O3a self-consistency
headline_value: For every fixed n>=2, max and min 2n-switch self-consistent points are each unique and symmetric for all sufficiently small positive R-1
scope: Every fixed integer n>=2, both saturation signs, and 1<R<1+epsilon_n for an n-dependent positive epsilon_n
main_limitation: No uniform epsilon in n and no uniqueness conclusion for arbitrary finite contrast

title: Finite-contrast properness and continuation reduction for multiphase O3a
headline_value: Self-consistent cells cannot collide or escape at finite contrast; all-contrast uniqueness reduces to interior residual-Jacobian nondegeneracy
scope: Every fixed n>=2 and sign over compact finite-contrast intervals, with a conditional continuation consequence over all finite R>1
main_limitation: Universal all-solution Jacobian nondegeneracy remains unproved, so the full O3a conjecture remains open
